description: Make a new plan in the traveller's Meridian Dispatch app: a title, a first day and a number of days, optionally with ops to fill it (the same ops as edit_plan). It appears on the website at once and in the app on its next sync. A free account holds one plan; members have as many as they like. Needs sign-in.

country_codes.description: ISO alpha-2 codes, the main country first.

ops.description: Optional: the same ops as edit_plan, applied at once.

name: create_plan
title: Make a new plan
